review_description: Everything was really smooth. Quote was done in a timely fashion. Paperwork and subsequent booking went well and stress free.Installation was on time as booked, quick service, great install and very neat. Everything well explained along the way.
Quoting process was simple.They emailed me whar was discussed over the phone.Installation was very smooth and tidy.Customer service was amazing and overall connection process was ver smooth.
The paperwork which they sent to energy supplier was not complete, this delayed the export of power from the solar system by at least 4 weeks

We wanted to go with one of the local suppliers in order to support Geelong industry but, although his quote was lower, he did not have the time to sit down with us and go through things in a manner we thought appropriate for a $10,000 investment. He forgot to return calls and keep appointments. We narrowed it down to two using 3rd party references.

Great service from day 1. Clean energy solar has help us all the way not only with price but great after sales service. Thoroughly recommend if your interested in purchasing solar without the pressure to sign straight away. Offered not only solar qoute but energy audit of house which opens your eyes into being more energy effecient. Service excellent overall.
